title: Cajun Seasoning
description: A smoky, peppery blend of paprika, herbs and garlic and onion granules that keeps as a pantry staple for seasoning chicken and rice dishes.
steps: Combine all ingredients; store in a jam jar or airtight container.
notes: Use in Cajun Chicken Rainbow Rice (p.55).
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
